data.name: describe_phenotype
data.rationale: Visual confirmation of cytoskeletal vs nuclear phenotype at high doses.

data.name: describe_phenotype
data.summary: Microscopist on 4 field(s): density lower vs DMSO; 4 observations; candidates: Aurora kinase inhibitors, unknown

observations.finding: All 4 treated fields (f_967dd3f63721, f_14132cc7aa30 at 10uM, 249 cells; f_e779e1bd4605, f_f5299274d0ad at 3uM, 320 cells) are markedly less confluent than DMSO control f_b7ce3f874263. DMSO is a dense polygonal monolayer; treated show scattered single cells and loose clusters with large black background gaps. Identical display contrast so difference is biological reduced cell number / increased spreading.

F-actin red: In treated, high contrast, sharp peripheral enrichment, spiky ruffles/filopodia and textured patches vs DMSO diffuse low-contrast red mesh along cell-cell contacts. Cells more elongated, non-convex borders.
Beta-tubulin green: In treated, brighter, more bundled and heterogeneous green signal in cell bodies and protrusions vs DMSO uniform dim green. Texture markedly coarser.

DNA blue (DAPI): Treated nuclei paler/dimmer blue, more diffuse chromatin vs DMSO bright uniform blue. Frequent enlarged nuclei and bi-/multinucleated cells, e.g. large multinucleate cells top-left and centre in f_967dd3f63721, central-bottom in f_f5299274d0ad. Nuclei more irregular, lobed/elongated vs DMSO round-oval uniform.

notable_cells.why: Giant cell with multiple DAPI masses, bright green tubulin halo, red actin rim
Cluster with extremely elongated green tubulin protrusions, >2 nuclei, spiky red edge
Typical enlarged pale blue nucleus, high-contrast green tubulin ring
Round isolated cell with uniform bright green cytoplasm, pale blue nucleus, dense red actin corona - example of altered tubulin/actin texture

candidate_mechanisms.why: Phenotype across both doses at 24h: decreased DAPI intensity with increased fraction large/irregular/multilobed nuclei (frac_large_nucleus z=9.3-9.4, nuc_dna_mean z=-8.2 to -9.8, nuc_form_factor z=-7.1), plus increased cell eccentricity z=8.2-9.0 and decreased solidity z=-15.9, cell spreading and reduced confluence. Aurora B failure of cytokinesis produces polyploid, large pale irregular nuclei with secondary cytoskeletal spreading and increased actin/tubulin heterogeneity (act_glcm_contrast z=28.9/19.4, act_std z=16.3/11.9, tub_glcm_contrast z=10.6/8.1, tub_std z=8.6/6.6). Both wells show same qualitative phenotype, 10uM slightly sparser and higher actin contrast than 3uM.

Without grayscale channels, mitotic figures/monoasters cannot be resolved; microtubule stabilizer/destabilizer or Eg5 inhibitor also give mitotic arrest and polyploidy but actin changes here are best explained as secondary to failed division. No compound guess.

report.uncertainty: Composite colour only limits detection of subtle microtubule destabilization vs stabilization; actin/tubulin z-scores may reflect cell shape change rather than direct target. Aurora signature is most parsimonious among list but confidence moderate; DNA damage/DNA replication cannot be excluded without cell-cycle marker.

data.name: describe_phenotype
data.rationale: Check visual phenotype at 1uM sub-cytotoxic dose to see if actin or nuclear changes dominate.

data.name: describe_phenotype
data.summary: Microscopist on 2 field(s): density lower vs DMSO; 6 observations; candidates: Aurora kinase inhibitors, unknown

observations.finding: Treated fields sparser than DMSO control: large black gaps, cells spread/flat rather than confluent monolayer. Mean cell footprint markedly larger.
Beta-tubulin (green) occupies larger cytoplasm, more diffuse/bright in enlarged cells vs compact perinuclear green in DMSO.
DNA (blue DAPI) visibly paler/dimmer and more diffuse in treated nuclei vs brighter uniform blue in DMSO at identical contrast.

Nuclei larger on average, more round/circular, contour more regular. Occasional very large nuclei and binucleate cells (e.g. large flat green cell lower-left f_88c7671ef99c, lower-left binucleate cell f_9e9d0813afb1) not seen in DMSO.
F-actin (red) at cell periphery more spiky/irregular with filopodia-like protrusions, cell outline less solid/compact, actin texture more contrasted vs smooth cortical red in DMSO.
Cytoplasm-to-nucleus ratio increased: enlarged green/red cytoplasm surrounding modestly enlarged blue nuclei.

notable_cells.why: enlarged flat cell with very large round nucleus
enlarged flat binucleate cell, example of failed cytokinesis/polyploidization

candidate_mechanisms.why: enlarged flat cells, increased cell area and cell/nuc area ratio, infrequent very large/binucleate nuclei with decreased DAPI mean intensity and decreased eccentricity/increased solidity - classic cytokinesis-failure/polyploid phenotype; no strong microtubule bundling/spindle phenotype, no actin loss. Consistent with frac_large_nucleus +5.2, cell_area +4.7, cell_nuc_area_ratio +4.4, nuc_dna_mean -7.8, nuc_eccentricity -7.6, nuc_solidity +4.6
alternative generic G2/M arrest / DNA replication stress could also produce large cells/pale DNA; composite alone without mitotic figures insufficient for definitive call

report.uncertainty: moderate - phenotype clearly cytokinetic failure / senescence-like enlargement, most compatible with Aurora in this list but DNA-damage/replication classes overlap; no separate grayscale channel to quantify tubulin/actin filaments
